research_result.description: WhatsApp Business Platform provides APIs including the Cloud API, Business Management API, and Marketing Messages API to programmatically send messages, manage account assets, and receive real-time updates via webhooks.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can register for a Meta Developer account, create a Meta app with the WhatsApp use case, and obtain a temporary access token and test phone number from the dashboard. For production, developers create a System User in Meta Business Settings and assign tokens with whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management permissions.

evidence.claim: WhatsApp Business Platform provides enterprise APIs for messaging and calling.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Drive revenue growth, boost efficiency, and deliver exceptional customer experiences with the WhatsApp Business Platform—our enterprise-grade APIs for messaging and calling.

evidence.claim: WhatsApp API uses OAuth access tokens provided in Authorization Bearer headers for API requests.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Authentication uses OAuth (not 2.0) access tokens, while permissions restrict access to specific resources.

evidence.claim: Developers can quickly get started for free by registering as a developer, creating a Meta app, and obtaining test tokens.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: This guide helps developers quickly get started with the WhatsApp Cloud API. It covers the basic setup steps, including registering as a developer, creating a Meta app, sending your first message, and setting up a test webhook endpoint.

evidence.claim: Multiple community and open-source MCP servers exist for WhatsApp Business Cloud API.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: WBMCP is an MCP server and TypeScript SDK for the official WhatsApp Business Cloud API.
